perspective:
Arthur’s available information:

- Arthur knows he is Arthur Chung, a highly educated plumber, and that he works professionally with Teresa Ortega, a medical assistant, on community service projects.
- During the current community service project, he observes Teresa working hard and appearing overwhelmed. He feels concerned and believes she needs help.
- Arthur initiates help by saying he noticed she seems overwhelmed and asks if he can assist. He hears Teresa say she thinks she can manage but there is a lot to do.
- Arthur says it is important for her to take care of herself and offers to help so they can finish faster together. Teresa replies that if he insists, she could use help organizing medical supplies. Arthur agrees to start.
- Arthur believes Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability. He feels empathetic and wants to reassure her that accepting help does not undermine her ability.
- Arthur tells Teresa he admires her desire to handle everything alone, but accepting help does not mean she is incapable. He hears Teresa say she wants to show she can do it by herself. He responds that teamwork can be more effective and it is not about proving anything. Teresa says he is right and she needs to remind herself of that. Arthur says they are in this together and he supports her.
- Arthur later believes Teresa is still struggling. He feels frustrated that his efforts to help are not yielding results and wants to support her without making her feel inadequate.
- Arthur tells Teresa he sees things are still tough and does not want her to feel she is not doing a great job. Teresa says it has been busy and she feels behind. Arthur suggests they work together on tasks to share the load. Teresa agrees. Arthur says they will tackle it as a team.
- Arthur believes working together will ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He feels hopeful and commits to the collaborative approach.
- Arthur tells Teresa he is hopeful the collaborative approach will make things easier. Teresa says it already feels less overwhelming. Arthur suggests he handle inventory while she manages patient records, with regular check-ins. Teresa agrees, and Arthur says they should make it a productive day.
- Arthur believes their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship. He feels satisfied and wants to maintain this approach in future projects.
- Arthur tells Teresa their teamwork paid off and they accomplished more together. Teresa agrees it was a great experience. Arthur suggests continuing the collaborative approach in future projects. Teresa says that is a fantastic idea and they are more efficient and effective as a team. Arthur says he looks forward to their next project, and Teresa thanks him for being a supportive colleague.
